title: Umuriro ugaragara uturutse kure
intro: Tekereza ikibaya cyijimye nijoro, urumuri ruri kure rumurika mu kirere, n'umugenzi wenyine ugenda yerekeza kuri urwo mucyo ashaka ubuyobozi, hanyuma agahabwa ubutumwa buzahangana n'ubwami kandi bubohore igihugu gikandamijwe.
clues: Nashyizwe mu gasanduku ku ruzi nkiri uruhinja, Imana yantumye mama ahumekerwa n’ibyo Imana yavuze.
Nakuriye mu muryango w'umunyagitugu wakandamije ubwoko bwanjye.
Nahunze nyuma y'amakimbirane akomeye maze mara imyaka myinshi muri Madiyani ndi kuragira amatungo yo gukodesha.
Nabonye umuriro iruhande rw'umusozi maze ntangazwa n'ijwi riturutse mu kibaya cy'umugisha.
Nahawe ibimenyetso bibiri bikomeye mu ntoki zanjye: inkoni yahindutse inzoka n'ikiganza cyakaga cyera cyane.
Nari mpagaze na mukuru wanjye imbere y'umutegetsi wa Misiri, nyuma mbona inyanja icikamo kabiri kugira ngo dushobore guhunga.

trial.label: Igeragezwa/Ikibazo
options: Imana yahamagaye mu kibaya cy'umugisha maze imutuma kuri Farawo
Yubatse Inkuge kugira ngo irokoke Umwuzure
Yategetswe gutamba umwana w'umuhungu mu nzozi
Yasobanuye inzozi z'inka ndwi zibyibushye ku mwami
Yamizwe n'ifi nini mu nyanja nini
trial.answer: Imana yahamagaye mu kibaya cy'umugisha maze imutuma kuri Farawo

outcome.label: Ibisubizo
options: Ingabo za Farawo zarohamye maze Abana ba Isirayeli barakizwa
outcome.answer: Ingabo za Farawo zarohamye maze Abana ba Isirayeli barakizwa
